mapper.select: SELECT g.*, c.name AS campaign_name, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS target_count FROM ecom_ad_group g JOIN ecom_ad_campaign c ON c.id = g.campaign_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ad_group_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecom_ad_target WHERE target_type <> 'NEGATIVE' GROUP BY ad_group_id) t ON t.ad_group_id = g.id WHERE g.campaign_id = #{campaignId} ORDER BY g.name
